fire._doc: Fire spread (D-126, sim/fire_spread.gd). A burning building heats each neighbour within reach m of its footprint (plus ember_reach m per Ember Rain level) by heat_rate a second at a touching wall, less with the gap, x (1 + fire_rate) x (1 + fire_wind x downwind) x flammability by building style; heat cools at cool_rate a second with no fire near. At heat 1 it glows glow_seconds, then burns burn_seconds + burn_per_floor x floors and burns out: its lowest burn_out_floors floors take burn_out_damage a chunk over burn_out_seconds in burn_out_steps batches, the downwind side first, and the rest drops and topples like a smashed building (D-129); what it drops pays burn_pay of a smash x the conflagration (+conflag_step a burn-out, to conflag_max, decaying conflag_decay a second; conflag_max keeps a burn-out near 60% of a smash, never more, D-126), x far_pay past far_radius m from the kaiju. Ignition (D-129): the beam's burning coat always, each building the breath reaches with chance breath_ignite, a stray army shell within shell_reach m with chance shell_ignite. grid: the footprint index cell, m; the heat pass runs every spread_tick s; view_size: the size of each fire the view puts on a burning building's roof, one per roof quarter on a roof at least view_spacing m across (else one); view_out_fade: seconds a fire on a breaking or falling chunk takes to dim out. Firestorm blasts grow firestorm_grow a level past the first. PLACEHOLDERS flagged for tuning (D-129): every number here and the five nodes' places and costs in data/upgrades.json (r_ablaze .. r_firestorm).

heli_wreck._note: How a downed helicopter looks (HeliWreck, HeliFx, HeliDebris; D-140/D-141/D-145), judged at the game camera (about 18 px per metre at 1080p). Kill (burst): a flare of flare_size m for flare_seconds, a light of burst_light for burst_light_seconds, a ball of fireball_tongues smooth flame tongues (fireball_tongue x the street tongue, graded over fireball_flame_h m) thrown fireball_speed_min..max m/s and climbing with fireball_rise m/s2 (blooms for fireball_seconds, fireball_radius m), a puff of smoke_puffs smoke quads smoke_size m for smoke_seconds (young smoke tinted smoke_warm then smoke_mid), Fire burst_fire for burst_seconds, the model's parts thrown throw_min..max m/s sideways and up to up_max (the body and tail rotor trailing a Fire of part_fire), plus burst_shards chunks (burst_burning of them burning at shard_fire). Spin: hit_flare, hit_light, hit_smoke; three Fires of trail_fire spaced trail_offset m along the hull (a flame body), a dark smoke trail of trail_puffs puffs trail_smoke_size m for trail_smoke_seconds (tinted trail_warm and trail_mid, trail_self_lit glow); its path bows swing m sideways; spins at spin rad/s, pitches pitch_deg and rolls roll_deg by the landing; crew chutes fall at chute_speed m/s under a canopy canopy_width m wide hung canopy_hang m above them (canopy_glow emission). Crash: crash_flare, crash_light for crash_light_seconds, a crash_fireball-scaled fireball and crash_smoke-scaled puff, a ground Fire of crash_fire left burning, dust of crash_scale and a street-dust ring crash_ring times that, crash_shards chunks, the rotors thrown and the body left lying. Chunks fall at gravity m/s2, lie rest_seconds, then shrink away over fade_seconds.

strike._note: Damage lands on impact (D-166, D-175; Strikes): the reptilian's big attacks wreck when the jaws or the foot land, a beat after the press, not on it. breath = seconds from the press to the strike by size tier (young, Behemoth, Colossus); the cone is read at the strike, from where he faces then. beam = seconds from the press to the Thunder Beam stream (the walk slow, powers.beam_move_mult, starts at the press). stomp_standing = seconds from a stomp tick to its damage when he stands still (a walking stomp lands on its tick; the view syncs it to the footfall). Cooldowns count from the press. Nothing lands if the rampage ends or the size tier changes first. The dash is instant (the crouch is view-only, D-165). The events carry the time: strike_windup (kind, strike_in) at the press for the breath and the beam, strike_in on the stomp event.

air._note_deaths: How a helicopter dies (D-140, D-141, D-145; AirWing): a killing blow of at least blow_apart x its hp blows it apart in the air; a lighter one sends it spinning down for fall_seconds, drifting fall_drift units, crew bailing out with chance bailout_chance (1..bailout_max of them); the wreck smashes crash_floors floors within crash_radius for crash_damage and sets the building it hits burning (City Ablaze). Placeholders, flagged for tuning.
air._note_flight: How a helicopter flies (D-183 Stand-off gunships, AirFlight). Distances marked (x scale) are in model units times the kaiju's body scale, so they grow with him: a claw rake reaches 13 x scale ahead (powers.swipe_far) and its band is up to about 4.6 x scale wide, the breath reaches 25 x scale or more. Each helicopter steers for its slot: a point on its own ring round the kaiju that goes where he goes (standoff = the ring (x scale), standoff_jitter = how far each one's own ring differs, spawn_far = rings out it flies in from). heli_speed (units a second), heli_accel (units a second squared) and heli_turn_deg (degrees a second, its nose) are its limits, so it glides and backs off without a jerk; its nose follows its flight from nose_share of top speed up and faces the kaiju below it; arrive = how close to its goal counts as there (it hovers facing him). The pilots take the kaiju to be where he was over the last anchor_seconds (his stepped turns swing his position ten units or more about the planted foot, which they do not chase) and put each slot lead_seconds of his walk ahead, so a helicopter backs off before he is on it. pull_back = the kaiju within this (x scale) of it puts its slot straight behind it (under standoff x (1 - standoff_jitter)). hold_seconds = how long it keeps a slot, glide_deg = how far along the ring it moves to the next, slot_tries = candidate slots tried for room from the others. clear_arc (and clear_lead_deg more, for lag) = the camera side no slot enters. Strafing: one pass at a time, strafe_gap seconds apart (strafe_retry later when no helicopter slot is within strafe_reach_deg of the line entry), a fly-by at full speed along a straight line that passes strafe_close (x scale) from the kaiju on the flank (the camera's view along him) on the side of the helicopter's slot, turned on until it keeps clear of the corridor of pass_corridor (x scale) each side of the camera's line to him, so it never flies between the camera and him, aimed strafe_lead seconds of his walk ahead, lined up first (it flies to the line's entry end and hovers there, as at a slot) and then run by following a point strafe_carrot (x scale) ahead along it, the line bending outward past him by strafe_veer (so it turns away from the corridor), over strafe_exit (x scale) past him, where it turns back out to its slot (strafe_seconds the longest). Placeholders, flagged for tuning.

vip._note: The leader's escape helicopter (VipHeli, D-149, director 2026-10-25 'go'): once a rampage, at a seeded moment (window = share of the run), the city's leader (ranks by size tier: Mayor, Governor, President) lifts off a standing mid-rise (pad_height floors, pad_range m from the kaiju, else any) and climbs over climb_seconds while it flies one banked lap of circle_radius (x body scale) in circle_seconds, then runs for the map edge away from the kaiju (exit_spread_deg either side, no faster than turn_limit rad/s, gathering speed at accel) so the flight lasts about window_seconds (escape_cap x window_seconds is the longest it may fly); it escapes at exit_margin past the arena edge. payout[tier] = about one city block's worth of biomass (a block's mean in-arena building value, measured by tests/run_vip_tests.gd per city size; a kill pays it x the kaiju's rubble_mult, an escape pays nothing and loses only that). hp = the air wing's hp x hp_mult; radius = hit radius; throw_pass / throw_ceiling = how close a thrown tank or car must fly, and how low the leader must be, to bring it down. rotor_pitch / rotor_db: its own rotor sound (the cleared heli_rotor.ogg, lower and louder). Headlines go to the news strip ({rank} is the rank): liftoff, killed, escaped (mocking), shown headline_seconds. gold / white = the VIP look (white body, gold rotors and trim). bank / pitch = radians the model leans a turn rad/s and a ground speed unit; turn = how quickly its heading follows the sim's (as heli_turn); rotor_unit = the rotor sound's reach (a 3D unit size). Placeholders flagged for tuning.

taskforce._note: The Anti Kaiju Taskforce, agents only (Taskforce, TaskforceFrost, TaskforceVolley; D-137, D-139, D-141, D-143, D-145). PLACEHOLDER NUMBERS (tune) except the director's: railgun.share 0.08 of max health (D-143), railgun.aim_seconds 2.0 (D-139), railgun.cooldown 12 s per agent, frost.slow_mult 0.5 for frost.seconds 4 s, a kill pays a tank's worth (rubble_share 1.0 of army.tank_rubble) (D-152), squads of 3-4 and max 12 alive (D-139), none in the young city (D-137, D-152). max_by_tier = most alive at once per size tier (young, adolescent, ...). The Taskforce joins every rampage once first_arrival.city_seconds of rampage time are carried in from earlier rampages in the adolescent city or later (D-160, the save keeps the counter), its first squad first_arrival.run_delay seconds in, then every start_interval seconds less escalation_per_chunk x chunks destroyed (never under min_interval): faster the more of the city falls (D-145). Agents jetpack in from a ring edge_inset past the arena at jet_speed (units a second) and cruise jet_height up, then perch on the highest standing chunk of a column of a building at least perch_min_height tall, perch_range [near, far] from the kaiju, trying perch_tries chunks (with no building in the band, one of the perch_fallback nearest to it); a perched agent hops on after perch_seconds [min, max] (hop speed = jet_speed x hop_speed_share, arcing hop_arc up). rubble_share = biomass per kill as a share of this city's tank_rubble (x the kaiju's rubble_mult). hover_seconds = how long an agent with no roof to go to hovers before looking again, min_flight_s = the shortest flight. first_charge = the share of a cooldown a fresh agent has already waited. railgun: armour (stat armor) is taken off a hit as for a tank shell, never below army.min_damage; the line tracks the kaiju for aim_seconds - lock_seconds, then locks and lands on the lock; lock_seconds per growth stage (lock_seconds_by_stage, baby/adolescent/adult; director 2026-10-26 "Longer warning, scaled by size": a leap pressed at the lock, crouch included, clears the whole volley; was 0.4); it hits for share x max health only if the kaiju is within hit_radius of the lock (a late step dodges it); cooldown, range, hop_after (seconds before it hops on), squad_gap (D-166, D-178 Lock together, fire in turn: a squad's ready gunners put their lines up together and the lines lock at the same moment on one point, aim_seconds - lock_seconds after; the shots then land that many seconds apart, the first aim_seconds after the lines go up; over 0.5 so one squad never lands more than 2 hits in a second, and one leap at the lock leaves the kaiju clear of the whole volley; 0.6 is the pick inside about 2 hits' worth in a second). frost: cooldown per agent, range, flight_s grenade flight, radius (1.5) it must land within (the kaiju's feet: walking dodges, standing still is caught, D-161), seconds of slow, slow_mult speed multiplier; refreshes, never stacks, the dash shatters it. swat: radius of an agent hit by a claw swipe in the air; wall_range how far it looks for the wall it spins into.

convoy._yield_cap: A tank giving way yields at most stuck x yield_cap seconds in one stretch, however long the tank it makes way for stays held up; then it re-plans (TankSpacing.yield_limit).

blast_fx._note: How the red barrels look and sound going off (BlastFx, BlastParts; director comments #19, #20). Sizes scale with the sim's blast radius (explosives.*.radius). shake.trauma: how hard each kind of blast kicks the camera (times 1 - distance/reach from the kaiju); kick = ONE kick of units x that, thrown up and away from the blast and easing out (squared) over kick.seconds, never a shake back and forth (clip critic round 6); no screen flash (director 2026-10-27: cut), no hit-stop and no screen-bending ripple any more. sound.speed: the speed of sound in map units/s (343 m/s at about 3.5 m a unit, one floor); the sonic boom plays that late, from boom_from units away, never later than boom_max_delay; every blast cracks once, crack_db over the mix with no distance fade (round 7: the third blast's crack barely cleared the bed), body and rumble sit tail_db under it. flash.max_live: real lights at once (LightPool keeps lights.pool_size for lamps and fires). Motion critic fix round 2026-10-21: core = white-hot voxels out of the site box for core.seconds (a few frames), thrown core.throw radii; fireball.top_scale x reach_scale = how far the ball reaches (round 2, 7), speed_scale = start speed in radii/s (round 6: 2-3x the footprint), build_seconds = it spawns over that long (a few frames, not one), fireball = a sudden tall burst of Fire's own flames (Fire.FLAME_CUBE voxels at Fire.FLAME_SCALE, its ember shader at its own heat, its colours and ramp: a bigger blast is more flames, never bigger cubes): amount of them at blast radius 5, spawned over burst_seconds, living seconds, up on a spread (degrees) with gravity lift up like Fire's, speed_scale radii a second, damped to stop top_scale site heights up; fire = the real Fire left at the site afterwards (size x radius/5; seconds 0: it stays burning like any other until the fire cap puts the oldest out) which brings the game's own smoke (D-151, VFX lead 2026-10-23); shock.ring = the game's dust shockwave out to the blast's reach plus puffs Fx.dust round its rim; cloud = the chem gas as the game's soft smoke tinted shades, puff = its size range, shock.ring = small pale dust cubes (round 3: opaque lit voxels, no smooth parts) running out on a thin ring to max(footprint_scale x the site's widest side / 2, 2 x blast radius) in ring.seconds; break = how a site the blast reaches lets go: slices steps a frame each, top first, pieces thrown push out and up; cloud = green cubes in shades, a burst of amount then boil_amount boiling for the sim's cloud seconds, in size_scale x the lab box (at least cloud_share x the sim cloud radius wide), each living billow_seconds; round 5: core.full_radius = the blast radius whose flash is full strength (smaller blasts flash down to half), cloud.glow = shade multiplier (just over 1 glows faintly), cloud.boil = [life share, scale] points of each gas cube, no city fire at a blast (its soft smoke column sheeted over the facades); site_rubble = how high a flattened site blows from.

far_fog._note: Director comment #37 (2026-10-25, asked twice: 'something funky going on with the distant city'): the far city floated crisp above the haze, its own gentler haze (far_haze) and no engine fog, so it was clearer than the bay in front of it. on: the far skyline (towers, quay, lattice tower, the far rampage's beast and smoke) takes the engine's depth fog as the bay does (FarHaze); own_haze: the share of its own built haze kept on top (0 = the same air as the bay); base: height fog, this much more haze at the foot of the far city fading over base_height metres up, so it shows no hard base line (0.5: its foot within 2% of the bay's luma at night and noon, tools/capture/far_city_bars.py); start: metres from the camera where its own haze and the height fog begin. Off = the look it was built with. Presentation only.

stream_view._note: BuildingStream spends the stream_chunks budget on what the camera sees, not on a circle round the kaiju: a building ranks by its distance from the camera, or from the kaiju plus kaiju_extra_m, whichever is less; one that lies only in the margin band (margin_deg wide, each side of the frustum) ranks side_m farther, one outside that outside_m farther; a ring of ring_m round the camera has no penalty. margin_deg covers the camera's shake (camera_shake max_deg 2.5, a test checks it) and a quick turn, so a turn meets buildings the plan has already meshed (the breath's side orbit was cut, D-136). A landmark stays meshed while the frustum or the margin band reaches it or it stands within landmark_keep_m of the camera or the kaiju (a test checks no landmark is ever a box in view); beyond all three it unloads like any building (director 2026-10-22: out-of-view landmarks may unload if no pop-in).

river_quay._note: RiverQuay (D-062): crate stacks along the water's street-side edge, every gap m, kerb m off the water, clear of bridge decks (deck_clear m) and crossings (node_clear m); low and top are [half width, height] in prop voxels (0.25 m).

sfx._voice_caps: SfxVoices (R 8.2): voices each category may hold at once; hero categories are never stolen and reserve_hero voices stay free for them; others steal their quietest voice; the same sound is not restarted within retrigger_ms

city_sound._doc: CitySound (D-155, panic then eerie quiet): one driver sets every city bed from the rampage's phase, 0 at the first stomp to 1 when the city is ruined. phase = destruction_weight of (destruction share / destruction_full) plus the rest of (people fled / population / fled_full), each capped at 1. curve: [phase, dB] keys, linear between; crowd is a trim on the crowd loop's own panic level (0 = untouched), every other bed is its level in dB. Panic (crowd, sirens) peaks early and is gone by the end; gunfire, fire and wind carry the ruined city.

music._doc: MusicLayers (D-125; briefs in docs/audio/music-briefs.md): one track per city (size tier 1..3: baby, adolescent, adult), split into 4 stems that fade in, in this order, on the same phase as the city beds (drums alone at first, then bass, lead, choir and pads in the final stretch), on one locked tempo (AudioStreamSynchronized). bpm is the take's tempo and bars its loop length in bars: change both when a Suno take lands at another tempo; every stem file must be exactly bars * beats_per_bar * 60 / bpm seconds long (lock_tolerance_s) or the loader warns. A stem whose file is missing plays as silence of that length. enter/full: the phases a stem starts and finishes fading in.

title._note: The title screen's live city at night (comments #88, #98): the far shore seen across the bay from the play area's quay on a slow camera drift, a district over there on fire; the kaiju is only implied. Ambience levels are dB on their buses; the UI click is -12, so the bed sits 20 dB or more under it.

camera._note: D-158: tilted up about 7.5 degrees (look y = 11 + 206 * tan(tilt)) so the colossus head is whole in frame and the shore line drops; the near ledge is deeper (shore.ledge_depth) so the water band is a third thinner, not thicker.

dusk._note: Director 2026-10-22: dusk could be fine without the glare: deep blue sky, a faint warm band at the horizon only, cool grey-blue towers. Critic: lift the skyline so it reads as its own time of day.

far._note: The game's own Fire (scenes/fire.gd) at this zoom: the same voxel flames, embers and charcoal smoke, every size and speed multiplied by zoom for the distance, density times the particles (the picture is zoom squared bigger), smoke_share the part of the zoom the smoke takes.

colossus._note: Director 2026-10-22: explosions now and then reveal the reptilian colossus in the inferno, dark against the fireball. The game's adult reptilian model baked to black silhouettes (tools/capture/bake_colossus.gd) and drawn as a card of the given height in metres, feet on the start point; one step along start + k * step per footfall, out and back over steps_out steps.

crown._note: VFX lead's fix: a crisp warm line along the skull and snout top edge only (uv x under extent), px thick at 2160 rows.

rail._note: The elevated railway (Rail; the director 2026-10-21 #63 "train stations + tracks with trains on them", #69 "Derail and smash"; 2026-10-25 "research train locomotion and derailment physics", the 022 result). A two-track viaduct up the north-south avenue nearest the middle, deck_y up, deck_width wide, tracks track_gap apart, from span[0] to span[1] x the city's half extent along z (crossing the river), its station at station_share of the way. Trains of cars (the first a locomotive), car_length long, coupler_gap apart, at most max_trains running, one every headway_s (the first after first_s), entering at enter_share of cruise, speeding up at accel, braking at brake (emergency for broken track), dwelling dwell_s. Scaled from metro practice (1.0 m/s2 accel and brake, 1.3 emergency) to the city's scale. The viaduct and station are voxel structures (structure): they carve and fall like buildings, and the track is broken wherever its deck is gone. A hit of derail_damage or more on a car (car_radius) derails its train: the hit car kicked sideways at kick, the rest folding alternately (yaw_rate, roll_rate), sliding with friction (a share of g; post-derailment estimates 0.4-0.6), spin_damp, a car off the deck falling and keeping land_keep of its speed on landing, a car within pile_share of a length of the one ahead sharing its speed. A train behind stops stop_short before it, or derails if it reaches it above crash_speed. The kaiju's body derails a train when it reaches the deck (body_share of its stomp radius). Each car pays rubble_share of army.tank_rubble (the vehicle rule) and a derailment derail_bonus once on top (the director, 022 update: a big one-off bonus, well above a car; he judges it in playtest). PLACEHOLDER NUMBERS (tune).

structure._note: The viaduct and station as voxel structures in the city's buildings (RailLayout, D-247; the director 2026-10-26 "carve is a universal feature for all buildings"): pieces of piece_bays bays, column bents every bay_length; sizes in sim units: slab thick, parapet high and wide, column square, column_inset from the deck edge, cap under the deck, ballast_half and rail_offset round each track, sleeper_every and seam_every along it; the station's platform wide, canopy over the deck, post_every along it, stair wide. They carve, fall and pay like any building (tier).

rail_look._note: The railway's look (TrainModel, RailView): car_size (width, height in units) of a metro car; colours: the cars, and the viaduct and station (RailVoxels draws the rail structure materials with them); sounds: rumble_db and slide_db at full, the rumble heard within hear_range of the kaiju, the horn when the kaiju comes within horn_range of a running train, again every horn_every seconds (one-shots heard in 3D, unit_size) (it keeps running, the horn blares); survivors_per_car people crawl out of each wrecked car crawl_s after the derailment and flee. Colours are PLACEHOLDERS for the VFX lead.

creation._note: D-207 Kaiju Creation, the new-game opening: a lab close-up on a petri dish and a rack of genomes; pick a genome, inject Special K (the kaiju juice, named by the director 2026-10-25), the kaiju genome takes over, the camera rushes into black with an egg crack, then the first run's river rise. titans: the rack in order; species is the species.json id a genome plays ("" = no titan to play yet); unlocked is the state a new player starts with, and a save's titans_unlocked list (save_key) unlocks more (the unlock rules are not decided, D-207). timing in seconds (ticks at 60 a second). Lab sizes in metres, one voxel size for the whole set; colours are PLACEHOLDERS for the VFX lead (juice: the kaiju's white-hot, pending R 17.6; behind the takeover's front the cells cool to the species' body colour, veins of them still burning). crack_sound names assets/sfx/<name>.ogg (made on ElevenLabs 2026-10-25 in the director's lab-sound list); with no file the cue is silent.

sounds._note: the lab's sounds (director 2026-10-25: "nice, clinical sfx for this scene, lab sounds and high-tech precision machinery whirring"; ElevenLabs, D-138): loops play from the first frame to the black; pick on choosing a genome; trip: the cue on entering each phase of an injector trip (CreationInjector.phase: 1 turn to the source, 3 draw, 5 turn back, 7 dispense); strike and crackle (a loop) at the takeover, overload at the second hit-stop (started overload_lead_s early: its whine leads to the bang), dive at the zoom; assets/sfx/<name>.ogg

lab._note: D-207 board (approved 2026-10-25): Tripo props voxelised at one block size (voxel, metres) under Shader Cinematic; the rack's vials, the monitor screens and the dish surface are located in each model's own cells. bolt: the takeover lightning drawn as branching white-hot cells (the croc breath's bolt shader is not on main yet). freeze_s: the hit-stops at the strike and the overload. Colours are PLACEHOLDERS for the VFX lead.

vials._note: rack cells: a liquid cell is saturated and bright with hue in hue_range; slot by local x (left vial seen from the front = x above split_hi); titan_slots: the vial each titan of the rack list fills (the croc in the vial nearest the dish, where the injector reaches it); port: the hole cut in the rack's top over the croc's vial (port_radius cells round the middle of its column, from port_from_y up) that the needle goes down through; the model's pale DNA print counts as liquid only inside the liquid columns (columns_x, column_z).

canister._note: the Special K canister (director 2026-10-25: "Own canister on the bench"; Tripo e7912fc4): its liquid is the violet glass (hue, min_saturation), drawn by the injector through a port in its lid (port_radius cells round its axis, from port_from_y up).

glass._note: the glass petri dish standing on the agar (cells): a ring inner..outer from the dish axis, height cells tall, its top row the bright rim; the lightning stays inside it; glint: the arc (degrees round the axis, x towards z) where the rim catches the key lamp in pure white; the agar steps in three tones from its middle to a darker ring at the glass (pixel-art glass and liquid: a dark desaturated body, a white highlight, a liquid brighter in the middle and darker at the walls)

bolt._note: the bolt glows hotter than the set (glow) and flickers to an electric violet (colors.bolt_flicker), not grey: grey cells read as specks.

injector._note: the director 2026-10-25: "injector rotates to the croc vial, drains it, moves to dish and puts croc gene into dish", then the same from the Special K canister; "Use image A whole". The Tripo injector in cells: a static post (cells below split_y and left of split_x; its column cross-section at profile_y repeated post_extend cells up) and a carriage (the boom and the syringe head) that rises on the post, turns about its axis (pivot) and slides in and out through it so the needle reaches every vial (the director 2026-10-25: "load the serpent and dragon serum into the vials, and ensure the clip is functional for all 3"). tip: the model's needle tip cell, lengthened by needle cells of thin steel (colors.needle); barrel: the head's glass, which fills as it draws. The post stands where the needle reaches both the dish and the croc vial (behind them); the canister stands canister_turn degrees round the post from the dish. Heights in metres: where the needle tip goes in the dish, the vial (through a port cut in the rack's top) and the canister, where it parks over the dish, and the clearance it swings at over the tallest thing on its path.

trips._note: shares of a trip, in order: rise, turn to the source, lower into it, draw, rise, turn back to the dish, lower into the agar, dispense, park over the dish (the injection ends the moment the needle reaches the agar: the strike; the Special K drains in the takeover)

camera._note: from the front right, high, so the injector's boom crosses the shot in profile and is whole even raised over the vial; nothing sits under the KAIJU CREATION banner or the genome panel (checked by projecting every prop's box, 2026-10-25).

zoom._note: the dive plunges straight along the shot's line of sight into the white-hot dish (position on that line, close over the agar), then cuts to black (black_from)

room._note: the lab room round the bench (the director 2026-10-25: "change the black interior to a laboratory setting"; asked, "Dark high-tech lab"): back and left walls of steel panels (panel: width, height in metres; seams dark), a rail at rail_y, status LEDs (leds) on some panels, shelves on the back wall with sample jars (jar: width, height in cells; a liquid of one of tints, glowing), two cable runs (ys) on brackets and a conduit up the left wall (conduit_z), wall screens on the left wall (z, y spans), a cold strip light at strip_y and its wash (washes: light positions, wash energy, wash_range). The room's block is voxel metres (behind the set, in the haze). Colours are PLACEHOLDERS for the VFX lead.

camera_shake._note: CameraShake (R 19.2): hits add trauma 0..1 (sources), it fades at decay_per_s; the camera turns by trauma squared on smooth noise (noise_hz noise units a second; 1.6 keeps a 60 fps frame under 5 px at 1080p at the 2 deg cap, motion critic 2026-10-21), yaw and pitch only, full trauma = deg_per_root_scale x sqrt(body scale) degrees, at most max_deg. A hit away from the focus fades from near_per_scale to far_per_scale body scales. default_motion: the camera-motion setting's default (0..1).

accessibility._note: Settings > ACCESSIBILITY (D-259). flash_scale: while Reduce flashing is on, every flash of light (explosion, muzzle and breath lights, flares, the end beat's screen flash, the lab's lightning white) is drawn at this share of its brightness, and the colour fringe never shows.

photo_mode._note: PhotoMode (D-259 'Photo mode: Yes, simple'): from the pause menu the world stays frozen and a free camera flies round the kaiju. radius_rest_multiple: how far from the kaiju's feet the camera may go, in multiples of the gameplay camera's distance at this body size (so it grows with the kaiju); min_height: the camera never sinks below this many world units over the ground (y 0); speed_rest_multiple: flying speed, those distances a second; look_deg_per_s: right-stick turn rate; mouse_deg_per_px: mouse turn per pixel moved; pitch_limit_deg: how far up or down the camera can tilt.

rumble._note: PadRumble (D-259 'Yes, scaled by size, with a toggle'): pad vibration, weak (high-frequency) and strong (low-frequency) motors 0..1 for seconds. footfall and stomp: one row per growth stage (baby, adolescent, adult), so the thud grows with the kaiju; collapse: a toppled building landing; breath: the buzz while the breath burns (its seconds) and, for the ultimate beam, for the beam's own seconds. Settings > ACCESSIBILITY > Rumble turns it off.

post_fx._note: PostFx (D-142, director 2026-10-22), presentation only, every graphics preset. Vignette: the screen edges darken (smoothstep from inner to outer of the corner distance, 0 = centre, 1 = corner) to alpha strength in color, always the same dark edge: low health is the HUD's heartbeat vignette alone (ui.hurt; director 2026-10-27: vignette only), with no red band here. The colour fringe (red and blue split apart toward the screen edges, px at 1080 lines) lasts seconds, peaks at attack of that time, and fires only on a top-tier impact: a stomp of radius stomp_min_radius or more (world units, a full-quake Behemoth up), a toppling part collapse_min_length or more long, or a single step costing the kaiju hit_hp_fraction of its max health; never twice within cooldown_s. The camera-motion setting scales the fringe.

skyline_rampage._note: Director 2026-10-25 'yes bring it back': a far insectoid rampaging through the skyline across the bay, on by default. Presentation only (SkylineRampage).

contact._note: bodies[species][stage].stomp_foot = [ahead, across] at body scale 1: where a stomp's foot comes down against kaiju_pos (design units ahead along the heading, and out to the left foot; the right foot mirrors it). The sim's stomp damages around that point (RampageSim._stomp), the point the drawn ring lands on (measured with tools/capture/probe_stomp_foot.gd). No entry: the stomp is centred on kaiju_pos.

leap._note: The dash button's leap (Dash, D-259 "a leap that lands on a building and crushes it with a shockwave (replaces the dash)"). Per species and stage (baby, adolescent, adult): reach / min_reach = how far the feet may land from where they stand (design units at body scale 1): the nearest standing building whose centre is in that band and within aim_half_angle_deg of the facing, else the full reach; a target that dwarfs the body (D-091), or a roof landing that would put the body inside such a building, is landed before instead: on the street, backed off along the flight line in landing_step units until clear. crouch_s (crouch and push), flight_s (airborne), settle_s (impact settle), recover_s (to walk-ready) are the reader's L1 frames at 30 fps (C:/kt/croc_kit/reference.md: 14+15+15+18 / 18+21+21+25 / 24+26+26+32); the body takes no stick through all four. The flight is a high arc onto the target's roof (director 2026-10-26 "High arc, lands on roof"; supersedes reader bar L5 for the sim path, LeapArc): its top clears every building the body passes over by clear (design units at body scale 1), the path sampled every landing_step units, the top raised by clear up to arc_tries times; through the settle the body sinks from the roof to the street as the building breaks under it. On contact one blow of damage hits at full force within ring (x body scale) and fades to nothing at twice it (shockwave), through the carve path; tanks in it slide outward by fling x the force. cooldown from the press. PLACEHOLDER NUMBERS (tune) except the phase times.

bolt._note: BoltRig/BoltView/bolt.gdshader (VFX_STYLE family 6, research 17): the Lightning Breath and the Thunder Beam. halo_mode picks the fringe colours round the white-hot axis (R 17.6 is the director's open question: amber / eye = the species' eye tint / violet = white with a violet fringe); the glow itself is the engine's bloom on the HDR axis (boost_core, fringe_boost). The Thunder Beam core is 1.8x the breath's. Strokes come at least stroke_gap apart (never more than 3 full flashes a second); between strokes the main channel holds at hold_level with a shallow wobble. All shapes are dimensionless (a share of the bolt's length) and seeded per breath (Seeds breath_bolt / thunder_bolt). Widths are metres at body scale 1.

street._doc: People run once the kaiju is within panic_per_scale x body scale m (at most panic_radius, an adult's), after panic_gawk s staring at it; they calm past calm_radius in the same proportion. A stomp crushes within its radius plus stomp_catch x body scale; a falling section reaches fall_spill m past its strip or walls, and people under it at its start freeze there (nobody outruns a falling tower).

heli_lights._note: Night flying lights on every gunship (D-183; one look across helicopters): red on the left and green on the right at wing height (wing = how far out, of half the hull's width), a white strobe on the tail (flash strobe_on of every strobe_period seconds, each helicopter on its own beat), a faint pale belly lamp so the underside reads, and self_light = every cell glows faintly in its own colour so the dark hull does not vanish against the night city; energies are the emission strength the bloom turns into glow; mast = lamp height in the hull's box. Placeholders for the critic.

lights._note: Positional lights (street lamps, fires, police beacons; R 12.1, R 12.2). Only the pool_size lights nearest the camera are real lights (gl_compatibility ignores every positional light past 32 a frame, rendering/limits/opengl/max_renderable_lights); the rest are their emissive voxels and glow. Each light also fades out with camera distance: begin and length in metres.

rain._note: Rain (WeatherView, VFX family 11, D-155 / director 2026-10-23 'Heavy, kaiju clear'). Streaks are screen-facing quads at one screen angle (the fall direction as the camera sees it), in three depth layers, each its own world-space volume that follows the camera; counts are x the graphics preset's particles ratio. len and width are shares of the viewport height (so a streak is as long and as thick on a 1080p and a 4K screen), speeds m/s, alphas 0..1, shares of life. Colours are the fog grey lifted toward white, never above max_channel (under the 0.9 bloom threshold). min_streak_share and min_streak_alpha are the floors the weather suite holds the look above (a rain you can see).

render_opt._note: Render plan 2026-10-26. night_clip_max: the most of a night still that may sit at 0-2 of 255 (item 4; tests/lib/night_clip.gd). Look flags live in data/looks.json: deband, agx_contrast, post_contrast.

death._note: The kaiju's death (director 2026-10-26, every kaiju; replaces D-267's belly-down slump): Special K overload. A death (reasons, SaveFile.DEATHS) plays the agonised stagger clip for stagger_s (clip death_stagger, frames 20-60 of the approved stagger at 24 fps), the stone creeps over him for stone_s, then he shatters (DeathOverload): shards of his own body (cell world units each at body scale 1, picked from his body discs) are thrown throw_min..throw_max (x body scale) and land after flight_s, each a blow of shard_damage within shard_radius on the top shard_floors floors of what it lands on. A Death Blast node (stat death_blast, 1 per node) adds a front of blast_damage that runs out to a ring round his body: his body's edge plus death_blast x per_node world units (director 2026-10-26 "Smaller: a ring round his body"; 5 / 10 / 15, node 3 about one street block), in blast_s, every floor, and it starts blast_after_s after the last shard lands (director 2026-10-27, D-294 "Shards first": his falling stone body smashes buildings, then the blast clears the rest). The run ends settle_s after the front (or the last shard with no node). Look: violet = Special K (creation.lab.colors.special_k); stone grey with per-block variation; placeholders, flagged for tuning.
